claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-009
Date of Incident: March 11, 2021
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:12 states 'THURSDAY, MARCH 11, 2021', which matches the claim.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 1818 hours to 1839 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:12 states 'THURSDAY, MARCH 11, 2021 AT 1819 HOURS', which aligns with the claim's time range of approximately 1818 to 1839 hours.

claims.claim_text: Location: Pacific Coast Highway, Laguna Beach, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:12 states '30514 COAST HIGHWAY LAGUNA BEACH, CA', which matches the claim's location.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Officer D. Kessler
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:12 lists 'OFFICER RYAN RADEL' and 'OFFICER MATTHEW MEYER' as involved officers, while the claim states 'Officer D. Kessler'.

claims.claim_text: Badge Number: 3891
Subject: Tyler Brandt, Male, approximately 30 years old, White, black sweatshirt, light blue t-shirt underneath
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a white Mercedes sedan, not a subject in a black sweatshirt and light blue t-shirt. The claim describes a person, while the video shows a vehicle.

claims.claim_text: Officer(s): Officer D. Kessler, Corporal A. Novak (PIT maneuver), Officer M. Trujillo, Sergeant R. Holt
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:12 lists 'OFFICER RYAN RADEL' and 'OFFICER MATTHEW MEYER' as involved officers, while the claim lists 'Officer D. Kessler, Corporal A. Novak (PIT maneuver), Officer M. Trujillo, Sergeant R. Holt'.

claims.claim_text: Witness(es): None at scene of shooting
On March 11, 2021, at approximately 1818 hours, I was driving southbound on Pacific Coast Highway in my marked Laguna Beach Police Department patrol vehicle
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows a view from inside a patrol vehicle driving on a road at dusk/night, consistent with the claim of driving southbound on Pacific Coast Highway.

claims.claim_text: I observed a white Mercedes sedan traveling southbound at a high rate of speed
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows a white Mercedes sedan driving ahead of the patrol vehicle at a high rate of speed, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: I attempted to pace the Mercedes and observed erratic driving behavior, including veering on and off the shoulder
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the white Mercedes veering onto the shoulder and then back onto the road, indicating erratic driving behavior.

claims.claim_text: I believed the driver was potentially impaired
I broadcast over the radio my intent to conduct a traffic stop and requested immediate backup at approximately 1819 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer approaching the vehicle, and the text slide states the officer broadcast intent to conduct a stop at 1819 hours.

claims.claim_text: The driver of the Mercedes initially appeared to comply, pulling the vehicle onto the northbound shoulder of Pacific Coast Highway
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the white Mercedes pulling onto the northbound shoulder, consistent with the claim of initial compliance.

claims.claim_text: I exited my patrol vehicle and began approaching the vehicle on the passenger side
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows an officer exiting the patrol vehicle and approaching the white Mercedes on the passenger side.

claims.claim_text: As I reached the rear quarter panel of the Mercedes, the driver abruptly accelerated away from the traffic stop
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the driver accelerated away, but the video shows the vehicle already stopped and the subject exiting, indicating the pursuit had already ended.

claims.claim_text: The driver made a hard-right turn across oncoming traffic
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the white Mercedes making a hard right turn across the road, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: A vehicle pursuit ensued
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the patrol vehicle pursuing the white Mercedes, indicating a pursuit ensued.

claims.claim_text: During the pursuit, the subject collided with two civilian vehicles, causing one vehicle to overturn
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the white Mercedes colliding with another vehicle, but it is unclear if two civilian vehicles were involved or if one overturned.

claims.claim_text: I continued the pursuit with emergency lights and sirens activated
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the patrol vehicle continuing the pursuit with emergency lights activated.

claims.claim_text: Additional Laguna Beach Police units joined the pursuit
An Orange County Sheriff helicopter provided aerial support
The subject reached speeds of approximately 90 miles per hour
The subject was observed driving on the wrong side of the road and swerving into oncoming traffic
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the white Mercedes driving on the wrong side of the road and swerving into oncoming traffic.

claims.claim_text: Laguna Beach Police officers successfully deployed a spike strip, which caused all four tires of the Mercedes to deflate
Despite the tire damage, the subject continued to flee
The subject continued driving on deflated tires for approximately two additional miles
Corporal Novak successfully executed a pursuit intervention technique (PIT) maneuver, bringing the Mercedes to a stop in the southbound lane of Pacific Coast Highway
The vehicle came to rest facing north
My patrol unit, Officer Trujillo's unit, and Sergeant Holt's unit took positions approximately 15 feet from the stopped Mercedes
All units had their takedown lights and spotlights illuminated and directed at the subject
I was positioned in the center, with Officer Trujillo to my left and Sergeant Holt to my right
Upon the vehicle coming to a stop, I observed the subject remain seated in the driver's seat for approximately 30 seconds, appearing to look around the interior of the vehicle
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject remaining seated in the driver's seat for approximately 30 seconds after the vehicle comes to a stop.

claims.claim_text: The subject then exited the vehicle and immediately turned to face the officers
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject exiting the vehicle and turning to face the officers.

claims.claim_text: The subject placed his left hand behind his back and made a distinct reaching motion toward his left hip area
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject placing his left hand behind his back and reaching toward his left hip, but it is unclear if this is consistent with reaching for a concealed firearm.

claims.claim_text: I interpreted this movement as consistent with someone reaching for a concealed firearm
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject reaching toward his left hip, but the officer's interpretation of this movement as reaching for a concealed firearm is not visually confirmed.

claims.claim_text: I commanded the subject to get on the ground
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer commanding the subject to get on the ground.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply and instead began advancing toward me and the other officers in a rapid, deliberate manner
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject did not comply and advanced, but the video shows the subject getting on the ground, indicating compliance.

claims.claim_text: The subject suddenly extended both arms forward at chest height with his hands together in a manner that simulated pointing a firearm directly at me
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject extending both arms forward at chest height with hands together, simulating pointing a firearm.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my department-issued Glock 17 firearm, firing four rounds at the subject at approximately 1839 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer discharging his firearm, with audible gunshots and muzzle flashes visible.

claims.claim_text: Despite being struck, the subject remained on his feet and continued advancing toward the officers
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject remaining on his feet and continuing to advance, but it is unclear if he remained on his feet despite being struck.

claims.claim_text: The subject yelled profanities at the officers while continuing to make threatening gestures consistent with pointing a weapon
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject yelling profanities and making threatening gestures consistent with pointing a weapon.

claims.claim_text: Officer Trujillo deployed his department-issued Taser, which struck the subject and caused him to fall to the ground
Sergeant Holt broadcast over the radio that shots had been fired and a Taser had been deployed
I approached the subject with Officer Trujillo, and we placed the subject in handcuffs
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer approaching the subject with another officer and placing the subject in handcuffs.

claims.claim_text: We immediately began rendering first aid
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer beginning to render first aid to the subject.

claims.claim_text: I conducted a search of the subject's person and recovered a small black semi-automatic pistol from the subject's right front waistband area
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer conducting a search of the subject's person and recovering a small black semi-automatic pistol from the subject's right front waistband area.

claims.claim_text: Laguna Beach Fire Department paramedics arrived at approximately 1848 hours
and transported the subject to Mission Hospital in Mission Viejo, where he underwent surgery
The subject survived his injuries, which included two gunshot wounds to the upper torso and one to the left forearm
